Thank you for sitting through that mess. I’m a big fan of the book Solaris and have always wondered what the story might be like with more shouting and weeing. (The Tarkovsky movie is a masterpiece. The one with George Clooney is great too, but people seem to start yelling when I say that so I'll just keep shhhhh.)

This one was made with edited stock images and lots of aimlessly messing around with photoshop oil paint actions for a few months. No AI image generation was involved. The poem near the end was a section of Dover Beach by Matthew Arnold - https://www.poetryfoundation.org/poems/43588/dover-beach
